experiments.notes: Per-launch AUTO POSTAĆ 1 toggle in MULTIBOX. Updater passes WOW112_AUTOCHAR_FIRST=1 only to selected child processes. UI persistence follow-up: URUCHOM, BG SOUND and AUTO POSTAĆ 1 are stored per account in the local DPAPI-backed account vault, restored on dialog open, and saved before launch or normal dialog close.
